0.title: Italian Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
0.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 egg
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup Parmesan cheese
2 cups tomato passata
0.instructions: Mix meat, egg, cheese, and breadcrumbs. Form into small balls. Simmer the meatballs directly in the tomato sauce for 20-25 minutes.

1.title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
1.ingredients:
12 oz spaghetti
5 oz guanciale or pancetta
4 large egg yolks
2 oz Pecorino Romano cheese, grated
Freshly cracked black pepper
1.instructions: Whisk egg yolks and cheese. Fry guanciale until crisp. Cook pasta and toss with guanciale. Remove from heat and stir in eggs.

2.title: Old-Fashioned Apple Pie
2.ingredients:
3 Granny Smith apples, sliced
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3/4 cup sugar
2 eggs
1/2 cup unsalted butter
1 tsp baking powder
2.instructions: Peel apples. Beat eggs and sugar, add butter and flour. Pour into pan, top with apples, and bake at 350°F.

3.title: French Onion Soup
3.ingredients:
4 yellow onions
1 quart beef broth
1/4 cup butter
1 tbsp flour
Toasted baguette
1 cup Gruyere cheese
3.instructions: Caramelize onions in butter. Add flour and broth. Simmer. Top with bread and cheese, then broil.

4.title: Saffron Risotto
4.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rice
1 pinch saffron
1 quart broth
1 onion
1/2 cup white wine
1/4 cup Parmesan
4.instructions: Sauté onion, toast rice. Deglaze with wine. Add broth gradually. Stir in saffron. Finish with butter and Parmesan.

5.title: Lemon and Dill Salmon
5.ingredients:
2 salmon fillets
1 lemon
2 tbsp fresh dill
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp sea salt
5.instructions: Season salmon with lemon, oil, salt, and dill. Bake in parchment at 400°F for 15 minutes.

6.title: Classic Greek Salad
6.ingredients:
3 tomatoes
1 cucumber
4 oz feta
1/2 cup olives
1/2 onion
1 tsp oregano
6.instructions: Combine chopped vegetables, feta and olives. Drizzle with olive oil and oregano.

7.title: Authentic Genoese Pesto
7.ingredients:
2 cups basil
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp pine nuts
1/2 cup Parmesan
1/2 cup olive oil
7.instructions: Crush garlic and pine nuts. Add basil and salt. Stir in cheese and oil until creamy.

8.title: Coconut Chicken Curry
8.ingredients:
1 lb chicken
2 tbsp curry powder
1 can coconut milk
1 cup rice
1 onion
8.instructions: Brown chicken and onions. Add curry and coconut milk. Simmer and serve over rice.

9.title: Fresh Mexican Guacamole
9.ingredients:
2 avocados
1 lime
1/2 white onion
1 tomato
1/4 cup cilantro
1 tsp jalapeno
9.instructions: Mash avocados. Fold in onion, tomato, cilantro, and jalapeno. Add lime juice and salt.

10.title: Homemade Meat Lasagna
10.ingredients:
Lasagna noodles
2 cups meat ragu
2 cups bechamel
1 cup Parmesan
10.instructions: Layer noodles, meat sauce, and bechamel. Top with Parmesan and bake at 375°F.

11.title: Herbed French Omelette
11.ingredients:
3 eggs
1 tbsp chives
1 tbsp parsley
1 tbsp butter
11.instructions: Whisk eggs with herbs. Melt butter and pour in eggs. Fold when the center is still runny.

12.title: Sicilian Caponata
12.ingredients:
2 eggplants
2 stalks celery
1 onion
1 cup tomato puree
2 tbsp capers
1/2 cup olives
2 tbsp vinegar
1 tbsp sugar
12.instructions: Fry eggplants. Sauté celery and onion with tomatoes. Mix in eggplant, vinegar, and sugar. Simmer.

13.title: Classic Tiramisu
13.ingredients:
Ladyfingers
1 cup mascarpone
3 eggs
1 cup espresso
1/2 cup sugar
Cocoa powder
13.instructions: Whisk yolks, sugar, and mascarpone. Fold in whites. Dip ladyfingers in coffee. Layer with cream. Chill.

14.title: Roasted Pumpkin Soup
14.ingredients:
2 lbs pumpkin
1 potato
1 leek
1 quart stock
1 sprig rosemary
14.instructions: Roast pumpkin and potato. Sauté leek, add roasted vegetables and stock. Simmer and blend.

15.title: Creamy Chickpea Hummus
15.ingredients:
1 can chickpeas
2 tbsp tahini
1 lemon
1 clove garlic
1 tsp paprika
2 tbsp olive oil
15.instructions: Process chickpeas, tahini, lemon, and garlic. Add water if thick. Serve with oil and paprika.

16.title: Zucchini Frittata
16.ingredients:
4 eggs
2 zucchinis
1/4 cup Parmesan
Fresh mint
1/2 onion
16.instructions: Sauté zucchini and onion. Whisk eggs with cheese and mint. Pour over vegetables and cook until set.

17.title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
17.ingredients:
1 loaf bread
4 tomatoes
2 cloves garlic
1/4 cup basil
3 tbsp olive oil
17.instructions: Toast bread, rub with garlic. Toss tomatoes with oil and basil. Spoon onto bread.

18.title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
18.ingredients:
7 oz chocolate
3 eggs
1/4 cup sugar
1/2 cup heavy cream
18.instructions: Melt chocolate. Stir in yolks. Fold in whipped egg whites and cream. Refrigerate.

19.title: Andalusian Gazpacho
19.ingredients:
6 tomatoes
1 bell pepper
1 cucumber
1 clove garlic
1 slice bread
2 tbsp vinegar
19.instructions: Blend vegetables with soaked bread. Strain and chill. Serve with olive oil.

20.title: Vegetarian Zucchini Carbonara
20.ingredients:
12 oz spaghetti
2 zucchinis
4 egg yolks
2 oz Pecorino
1 tbsp olive oil
Black pepper
20.instructions: Whisk yolks and Pecorino. Sauté zucchinis until crispy. Toss pasta with zucchinis, then fold in eggs.

21.title: Smoked Salmon Sea Carbonara
21.ingredients:
12 oz linguine
6 oz smoked salmon
3 egg yolks
1/2 cup Parmesan
1 tbsp butter
Chives
21.instructions: Whisk yolks and Parmesan. Sauté salmon in butter. Toss pasta with salmon and stir in eggs.

22.title: Asparagus and Turmeric Carbonara
22.ingredients:
12 oz rigatoni
1 bunch asparagus
4 egg yolks
2 oz Pecorino
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 clove garlic
22.instructions: Sauté asparagus with garlic. Whisk yolks with cheese and turmeric. Toss pasta with asparagus and egg cream.

23.title: Spicy Nduja Carbonara
23.ingredients:
12 oz spaghetti
2 oz Nduja
4 egg yolks
2 oz Pecorino
Red onion
23.instructions: Melt Nduja with onion. Toss spaghetti in spicy oil. Remove from heat and stir in egg mixture.

24.title: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
24.ingredients:
2 salmon fillets
1 bunch asparagus
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Salt and pepper
24.instructions: Grill salmon and asparagus with oil and seasonings. Serve with lemon wedges.

25.title: Spicy Tomato Arrabiata
25.ingredients:
12 oz penne
2 cups tomato passata
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp red chili flakes
Olive oil
25.instructions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil. Add tomato sauce and simmer. Toss with cooked penne.

26.title: Eggplant Parmesan (Melanzane)
26.ingredients:
2 eggplants
2 cups tomato sauce
1 cup mozzarella
1/2 cup Parmesan
Fresh basil
26.instructions: Fry eggplant slices. Layer with sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan. Bake at 375°F until bubbly.

27.title: Thai Green Curry
27.ingredients:
1 lb chicken
2 tbsp green curry paste
1 can coconut milk
Bamboo shoots
Fish sauce
Basil
27.instructions: Simmer curry paste in coconut milk. Add chicken and bamboo shoots. Season with fish sauce and basil.

28.title: Traditional Beef Stew
28.ingredients:
1 lb beef chunks
2 potatoes
2 carrots
1 onion
2 cups beef broth
Rosemary
28.instructions: Sear beef. Add chopped vegetables, broth, and rosemary. Simmer for 90 minutes until tender.

29.title: Minestrone Vegetable Soup
29.ingredients:
2 zucchinis
2 potatoes
1 cup beans
1 cup tomato puree
1 quart vegetable stock
29.instructions: Chop all vegetables. Simmer in stock and tomato puree for 45 minutes. Serve with olive oil.

30.title: Mushroom Risotto
30.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rice
1 lb mushrooms
1 quart broth
1/4 cup Parmesan
Butter
Garlic
30.instructions: Sauté mushrooms with garlic. Toast rice, add broth slowly. Stir in mushrooms and finish with Parmesan.

31.title: Pasta e Fagioli
31.ingredients:
1 cup borlotti beans
8 oz ditalini pasta
2 cups tomato puree
2 cloves garlic
1 sprig rosemary
1 quart vegetable broth
31.instructions: Simmer beans with garlic and rosemary. Add tomato puree and broth. Cook pasta directly in the soup until al dente.

32.title: Neapolitan Pizza Margherita
32.ingredients:
1 lb pizza dough
1 cup San Marzano tomatoes, crushed
6 oz fresh mozzarella
Fresh basil
2 tbsp olive oil
32.instructions: Stretch dough thin. Spread crushed tomatoes, add mozzarella. Bake at maximum oven heat. Add fresh basil after baking.

33.title: Penne all'Arrabbiata with Tuna
33.ingredients:
12 oz penne
1 can tuna in oil
2 cups tomato passata
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp chili flakes
Parsley
33.instructions: Sauté garlic and chili. Add tomato sauce and tuna. Simmer and toss with cooked penne and parsley.

34.title: Slow-Cooked Lamb Ragu
34.ingredients:
1 lb lamb shoulder
2 cups crushed tomatoes
1 carrot
1 onion
1/2 cup red wine
Fresh thyme
34.instructions: Brown lamb in batches. Add wine, tomatoes, and vegetables. Braise covered for 2.5 hours. Shred and serve over pappardelle.

35.title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
35.ingredients:
12 cannelloni tubes
2 cups ricotta
2 cups spinach, blanched
1 cup béchamel
1 cup tomato sauce
1/2 cup Parmesan
35.instructions: Mix ricotta and spinach. Fill tubes. Cover with béchamel and tomato sauce. Top with Parmesan and bake at 375°F.

36.title: Baked Sea Bass with Capers and Olives
36.ingredients:
2 sea bass fillets
2 tbsp capers
1/2 cup green olives
3 tomatoes
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp olive oil
36.instructions: Place fish in baking dish. Top with garlic, capers, olives, and diced tomatoes. Drizzle oil and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

37.title: Potato Gnocchi with Gorgonzola Cream
37.ingredients:
2 lbs potatoes
1 1/2 cups flour
1 egg
4 oz gorgonzola
1/2 cup heavy cream
Walnuts
37.instructions: Boil and rice potatoes. Mix with flour and egg. Form gnocchi. Make gorgonzola cream. Boil gnocchi and toss with sauce and walnuts.

38.title: Panzanella Bread Salad
38.ingredients:
4 thick slices stale Tuscan bread
4 tomatoes
1 cucumber
1/2 red onion
1/4 cup basil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
4 tbsp olive oil
38.instructions: Soak bread in water and squeeze dry. Tear and mix with chopped tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and basil. Dress with vinegar and oil.

39.title: Ribollita Tuscan Bean Soup
39.ingredients:
1 cup cannellini beans
1/2 head black cabbage (cavolo nero)
2 potatoes
2 carrots
1 quart vegetable broth
3 thick slices stale bread
2 cloves garlic
39.instructions: Sauté vegetables. Add beans and broth. Simmer 45 minutes. Add torn bread and let it thicken. Reboll (reheat) and serve with olive oil.

40.title: Farro Salad with Roasted Vegetables
40.ingredients:
1 cup farro
1 zucchini
1 red pepper
1/2 cup feta
1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes
3 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
40.instructions: Cook farro. Roast zucchini and pepper. Mix with farro, feta, sun-dried tomatoes, oil, and lemon juice.

41.title: Chicken Cacciatore
41.ingredients:
4 chicken thighs
1 onion
1 bell pepper
1 cup white wine
2 cups crushed tomatoes
1/2 cup olives
Rosemary
41.instructions: Brown chicken. Sauté onion and pepper. Add wine and reduce. Add tomatoes and olives. Braise 40 minutes.

42.title: Swordfish Sicilian Style
42.ingredients:
2 swordfish steaks
2 tbsp capers
1/4 cup olives
2 tomatoes
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp olive oil
Mint
42.instructions: Sear swordfish. Make a sauce with garlic, tomatoes, capers, and olives. Spoon over fish and garnish with mint.

43.title: Polenta with Wild Mushrooms
43.ingredients:
1 cup polenta
1 lb mixed wild mushrooms
3 cups water or broth
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter
1/4 cup Parmesan
43.instructions: Cook polenta slowly in broth. Sauté mushrooms with garlic and butter. Serve mushrooms over soft polenta with Parmesan.

44.title: Cacio e Pepe
44.ingredients:
12 oz spaghetti or tonnarelli
2 oz Pecorino Romano, finely grated
1 oz Parmesan, finely grated
2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper
44.instructions: Toast pepper in dry pan. Cook pasta, reserve pasta water. Make cream with cheese and water. Toss pasta with pepper and cheese cream.

45.title: Amatriciana
45.ingredients:
12 oz rigatoni
4 oz guanciale
1 cup San Marzano tomatoes
1/2 tsp chili flakes
2 oz Pecorino Romano
Dry white wine
45.instructions: Render guanciale, add chili. Deglaze with wine. Add tomatoes and simmer. Toss with rigatoni and Pecorino.

46.title: Gricia
46.ingredients:
12 oz rigatoni
5 oz guanciale
2 oz Pecorino Romano
Black pepper
Pasta water
46.instructions: Render guanciale. Cook pasta and reserve water. Make emulsion with Pecorino and pasta water. Toss with guanciale and pepper.

47.title: Pappardelle with Truffle and Mushrooms
47.ingredients:
12 oz pappardelle
1 lb mixed mushrooms
1 oz black truffle or truffle paste
2 tbsp butter
1 clove garlic
1/4 cup Parmesan
47.instructions: Sauté mushrooms with garlic and butter. Add truffle. Toss with cooked pappardelle and finish with Parmesan.

48.title: Cannoli Siciliani
48.ingredients:
12 cannoli shells
2 cups ricotta
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1/2 cup chocolate chips
1 tsp orange zest
Pistachios
48.instructions: Drain ricotta. Mix with sugar, chocolate chips, and orange zest. Fill shells just before serving. Dip ends in pistachios.

49.title: Panna Cotta with Berry Coulis
49.ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
1/4 cup sugar
2 tsp gelatin
1 tsp vanilla
1 cup mixed berries
2 tbsp sugar (for coulis)
49.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in warm cream with sugar and vanilla. Pour into molds and chill overnight. Blend berries with sugar for coulis.

50.title: Osso Buco Milanese
50.ingredients:
4 veal shanks
1 onion
2 carrots
2 stalks celery
1 cup white wine
2 cups broth
1 can crushed tomatoes
Gremolata (parsley, lemon, garlic)
50.instructions: Dredge shanks in flour and brown. Sauté soffritto. Add wine, tomatoes, and broth. Braise 2 hours. Serve with gremolata.

51.title: Arancini Rice Balls
51.ingredients:
2 cups cooked saffron risotto (leftovers)
1 cup meat ragu
4 oz mozzarella, cubed
1 cup breadcrumbs
2 eggs
Oil for frying
51.instructions: Form risotto into balls around ragu and mozzarella. Dip in egg and breadcrumbs. Deep fry at 350°F until golden.

52.title: Vitello Tonnato
52.ingredients:
1 lb veal loin, roasted and sliced thin
1 can tuna in oil
2 tbsp capers
2 anchovy fillets
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1 lemon
52.instructions: Blend tuna, capers, anchovies, mayo, and lemon into a sauce. Spoon generously over cold sliced veal. Garnish with capers.

53.title: Seafood Linguine alle Vongole
53.ingredients:
12 oz linguine
2 lbs clams
3 cloves garlic
1/2 cup white wine
1/4 cup parsley
3 tbsp olive oil
Chili flakes
53.instructions: Sauté garlic and chili. Add clams and wine. Cover until clams open. Toss with linguine and parsley.

54.title: Prawn Risotto with Bisque
54.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rice
1 lb prawns
1 onion
1/2 cup white wine
2 cups prawn bisque (homemade or prepared)
1 cup broth
Chives
54.instructions: Sauté onion, toast rice, deglaze wine. Alternate bisque and broth. Add prawns in last 5 minutes. Garnish with chives.

55.title: Insalata Caprese
55.ingredients:
3 ripe tomatoes
8 oz fresh buffalo mozzarella
1/4 cup fresh basil
3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
Sea salt
Black pepper
55.instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella. Alternate slices on plate. Add basil, drizzle generously with olive oil, season, and serve.

56.title: Torta della Nonna
56.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/2 cup butter
1 cup sugar
3 eggs
2 cups pastry cream
Pine nuts
Powdered sugar
56.instructions: Make shortcrust pastry. Line tart tin. Fill with pastry cream. Cover with pastry. Top with pine nuts and bake at 350°F. Dust with powdered sugar.

57.title: Focaccia Genovese
57.ingredients:
3 cups flour
1 cup water
1/4 cup olive oil
1 tsp dry yeast
1 tsp salt
Flaky sea salt
Rosemary
57.instructions: Make dough and let it rise twice. Stretch into oiled pan and dimple vigorously. Top with oil, sea salt, and rosemary. Bake at 450°F until golden.

58.title: Crostata with Apricot Jam
58.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/2 cup butter
1/2 cup sugar
2 egg yolks
1 cup apricot jam
1 tsp lemon zest
58.instructions: Make shortcrust pastry with butter, sugar, and yolks. Rest in fridge. Line tart tin, spread jam, top with lattice strips. Bake at 350°F.

59.title: Bagna Cauda with Crudités
59.ingredients:
1/2 cup olive oil
4 tbsp butter
6 anchovy fillets
4 cloves garlic
Assorted raw vegetables (celery, peppers, carrots, fennel)
59.instructions: Slowly melt anchovies and garlic in oil and butter over very low heat. Serve warm as a dip for crudités.

60.title: Tuscan Ribollita with Cavolo Nero
60.ingredients:
1 cup borlotti beans
1/2 head cavolo nero
1 leek
2 potatoes
3 slices stale bread
1 quart vegetable broth
Olive oil
60.instructions: Cook beans separately. Sauté leek, add potatoes, cavolo nero, beans, and broth. Simmer. Add stale bread to thicken. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

61.title: Pan-Seared Tuna with Sesame Crust
61.ingredients:
2 tuna steaks
2 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp ginger
1 tbsp olive oil
1 lime
61.instructions: Coat tuna in sesame seeds. Sear 1-2 minutes per side. Mix soy, ginger, and lime for dipping sauce. Slice and serve rare.

62.title: Shakshuka
62.ingredients:
6 eggs
2 cups crushed tomatoes
1 red pepper
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
Fresh parsley
62.instructions: Sauté onion, pepper, and garlic. Add spices and tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes. Make wells and crack in eggs. Cover and cook until just set.

63.title: Taboule with Bulgur and Herbs
63.ingredients:
1 cup bulgur wheat
4 tomatoes, diced
1 cucumber
1 bunch parsley
1/4 cup mint
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
63.instructions: Soak bulgur in boiling water 20 minutes. Fluff and cool. Mix with vegetables and herbs. Dress generously with lemon and olive oil.

64.title: Japanese Miso Soup
64.ingredients:
4 cups dashi stock
3 tbsp white miso paste
4 oz firm tofu, cubed
2 tbsp dried wakame seaweed
2 spring onions, sliced
64.instructions: Heat dashi. Rehydrate wakame. Dissolve miso in a ladle of broth before stirring back in. Add tofu and wakame. Garnish with spring onions.

65.title: Lentil Soup with Cumin and Lemon
65.ingredients:
1 cup red lentils
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 lemon
1 quart vegetable broth
Olive oil
65.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic with spices. Add lentils and broth. Simmer 25 minutes. Blend partially. Squeeze lemon and finish with olive oil.

66.title: Greek Spanakopita
66.ingredients:
1 lb spinach, blanched
8 oz feta
3 eggs
1/2 onion
1/4 cup dill
10 sheets filo pastry
1/4 cup olive oil
66.instructions: Mix squeezed spinach, crumbled feta, eggs, and dill. Layer filo sheets with oil. Add filling, fold, top with remaining filo. Bake at 375°F.

67.title: Boeuf Bourguignon
67.ingredients:
2 lbs beef chuck
1 bottle red wine
1/2 lb lardons
1/2 lb button mushrooms
2 carrots
1 onion
Thyme and bay leaf
67.instructions: Marinate beef in wine overnight. Brown lardons, then beef. Braise with wine, vegetables, and herbs for 3 hours until very tender.

68.title: Ratatouille Provençale
68.ingredients:
1 eggplant
2 zucchinis
3 tomatoes
1 red pepper
1 yellow pepper
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
Provençal herbs
68.instructions: Roast vegetables separately. Combine in a pan with garlic and herbs. Simmer 20 minutes to meld flavors. Serve hot or at room temperature.

69.title: Turkish Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek)
69.ingredients:
1 cup red lentils
1 onion
1 carrot
1 potato
1 tsp red pepper flakes
1 tsp cumin
1 quart vegetable broth
2 tbsp butter
69.instructions: Sauté onion and carrot. Add lentils, potato, spices, and broth. Simmer 30 minutes and blend. Finish with butter-fried red pepper flakes.

70.title: Moussaka
70.ingredients:
2 eggplants
1 lb ground lamb
2 cups béchamel
2 cups tomato sauce
1 onion
1/2 cup Parmesan
1 tsp cinnamon
70.instructions: Fry eggplant slices. Brown lamb with onion, cinnamon, and tomato sauce. Layer eggplant and lamb. Top with béchamel and Parmesan. Bake at 375°F.

71.title: Pad Thai with Shrimp
71.ingredients:
8 oz rice noodles
1/2 lb shrimp
2 eggs
1/2 cup bean sprouts
3 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp tamarind paste
1 tbsp sugar
Peanuts and lime
71.instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry shrimp and push aside. Scramble eggs. Add noodles and sauce. Toss with sprouts. Serve with peanuts and lime.

72.title: Vietnamese Pho Bo
72.ingredients:
2 lbs beef bones
8 oz rice noodles
1/2 lb beef sirloin, sliced thin
1 onion
2-inch ginger
Star anise, cloves, cinnamon
Bean sprouts, basil, lime
72.instructions: Char onion and ginger. Simmer bones with spices for 3+ hours. Strain. Cook noodles. Pour boiling broth over raw beef slices. Serve with fresh herbs.

73.title: Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée
73.ingredients:
5 large onions
1 quart beef broth
1/2 cup dry white wine
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp flour
Baguette slices
1 cup Gruyere, grated
73.instructions: Caramelize onions slowly for 45 minutes. Add flour, wine, and broth. Simmer. Top bowls with baguette slices and cheese. Broil until bubbling.

74.title: Salmorejo Cordobes
74.ingredients:
2 lbs ripe tomatoes
1 cup white bread (crustless)
1 clove garlic
3 tbsp sherry vinegar
1/4 cup olive oil
Hard-boiled eggs and serrano ham (to garnish)
74.instructions: Blend tomatoes, bread, garlic, and vinegar until very smooth. Stream in olive oil. Chill. Serve with diced egg and ham on top.

75.title: Mango and Prawn Summer Rolls
75.ingredients:
8 rice paper wrappers
1/2 lb cooked prawns
1 mango, julienned
1 cucumber, julienned
1/2 cup fresh mint and basil
Rice vermicelli
Hoisin-peanut dipping sauce
75.instructions: Soak rice papers. Fill with noodles, prawns, mango, cucumber, and herbs. Roll tightly. Serve with hoisin-peanut sauce.

76.title: Chocolate Lava Cake
76.ingredients:
4 oz dark chocolate
4 tbsp butter
2 eggs
2 egg yolks
1/4 cup sugar
2 tbsp flour
76.instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Whisk eggs and sugar until fluffy. Fold into chocolate, add flour. Pour into buttered ramekins. Bake at 425°F for exactly 12 minutes.

77.title: Crème Brûlée
77.ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
5 egg yolks
1/2 cup sugar
1 vanilla bean
4 tbsp sugar (for topping)
77.instructions: Infuse cream with vanilla. Whisk yolks and sugar. Combine and strain. Bake in water bath at 325°F for 40 minutes. Chill. Sprinkle sugar and torch.

78.title: Tarte Tatin
78.ingredients:
4 large apples (Golden or Granny Smith)
1/2 cup sugar
4 tbsp butter
1 sheet puff pastry
78.instructions: Cook sugar and butter to amber caramel in oven-safe pan. Arrange apples and cook until softened. Cover with puff pastry. Bake at 400°F and invert while warm.

79.title: Salmon Tartare with Avocado
79.ingredients:
10 oz fresh sushi-grade salmon, diced
1 avocado, diced
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
1 lime
1 tsp fresh ginger
Sesame seeds
Chives
79.instructions: Dice salmon finely. Mix with soy, sesame oil, ginger, and lime juice. Arrange over diced avocado. Garnish with sesame seeds and chives.

80.title: Roasted Cauliflower with Tahini and Pomegranate
80.ingredients:
1 head cauliflower
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp cumin
3 tbsp tahini
1 lemon
1/4 cup pomegranate seeds
Parsley
80.instructions: Cut cauliflower into steaks. Roast at 425°F with cumin and olive oil until charred. Drizzle with tahini and lemon. Top with pomegranate seeds and parsley.

81.title: Butternut Squash and Ginger Soup
81.ingredients:
2 lbs butternut squash
1 onion
1-inch fresh ginger
1 quart vegetable broth
1/2 cup coconut cream
1 tsp coriander
81.instructions: Roast squash. Sauté onion and ginger. Add squash, broth, and coriander. Simmer and blend until smooth. Stir in coconut cream.

82.title: Steak Frites
82.ingredients:
2 rib-eye steaks
4 large potatoes
3 tbsp butter
2 cloves garlic
Thyme
Oil for frying
82.instructions: Double-fry potatoes. Sear steaks in butter with garlic and thyme, basting constantly. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with frites and mustard.
